answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the whisper check immediately, the prism audit keeps the resolved set and the ivory replay exposes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 229 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 229 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
